name: Darkspear Islands
summary: The Horde and Alliance fight across the Darkspear Islands off Kalimdor's coast. The ceremonial isles are sacred to Vol'jin's trolls, while the Alliance seeks a foothold on the shore and a chance to strike at the Horde's pride. Victory goes to the side that holds the strongpoints, seizes the Darkspear Islands flag and gathers 2000 resources first.

sections.title: Sacred Isles of the Darkspear
sections.body:
The Darkspear are an island people. Driven from Stranglethorn Vale by larger, crueler rivals, they made their lives among the islands of the southern seas. They keep these isles off Kalimdor's coast for their rites and the loa they honor.

On islands like these, Thrall's storm-wrecked fleet found Sen'jin's people beset by Kul Tiran sailors, murlocs and a sea witch. There, the trolls first swore themselves to the Horde. To a Darkspear, an enemy banner over the ceremonial grounds means desecration as well as defeat.

sections.title: Two Sides, Two Reasons
sections.body: For the Horde, holding the isles is a debt of honor. The Darkspear stood with Thrall when the Horde had little else, so orcs, tauren and Forsaken fight beside them to keep the trolls' holy ground. For the Alliance, these islands are a foothold off Kalimdor's coast and a way to strike where Horde pride runs deepest. Neither side speaks of peace. Every landing is answered, and every fallen camp is fought over again.

sections.title: The Shape of the Battle
sections.body: Numbers alone cannot hold the islands. The fighting runs from the Camp and the old Ruins to the Abandoned Tower and Shipwreck Cove. Each side builds up its store of resources by capturing and holding the strongpoints. Seizing the Darkspear Islands flag can turn the tide. The first side to gather 2000 resources wins the day and drives its enemies back to their ships, until the next landing.

faq.q: What is the Darkspear Islands battleground?
faq.answer: The Darkspear Islands are a battleground on the Darkspear trolls' ceremonial isles off Kalimdor's coast. Horde and Alliance forces fight to hold the strongpoints, seize the Darkspear Islands flag and be the first to gather 2000 resources.

faq.q: Why does the Horde fight for the Darkspear Islands?
aliases: why does the horde defend darkspear islands
why do the trolls fight there
faq.answer: The isles are sacred to the Darkspear trolls, Vol'jin's people. They joined the Horde after Thrall's fleet found them beset by Kul Tiran sailors, murlocs and a sea witch. Losing their ceremonial grounds to the Alliance would desecrate them, so the Horde fights to keep them.

faq.q: Why does the Alliance fight at the Darkspear Islands?
aliases: why does the alliance attack darkspear islands
faq.answer: For the Alliance, the islands are a foothold off Kalimdor's coast and a chance to strike at one of the Horde's proudest peoples. Each strongpoint taken is ground the Horde must fight to win back.

faq.q: How is the battle for the Darkspear Islands won?
faq.answer: Each side captures and holds the islands' strongpoints, building up its store of resources, and tries to seize the Darkspear Islands flag. The first side to gather 2000 resources wins.

faq.q: Where does the fighting happen on the islands?
faq.answer: The fighting ranges across the isles, from the Camp and the old Ruins to the Abandoned Tower and Shipwreck Cove. The struggle for each place rarely ends with a single charge.

The Darkspear are a tribe of jungle trolls led by Vol'jin. Driven from Stranglethorn Vale, they made their lives among the islands of the southern seas until Thrall's fleet found them. They have served the Horde loyally ever since, from Sen'jin Village in Durotar to every front of its wars.

angles.text: Every Horde fighter on these shores defends a promise. The Darkspear stood with Thrall when the Horde had little else, and their holy isles will not fall while the Horde can hold a blade.
For Alliance soldiers, each strongpoint taken on the Darkspear Islands is a foothold off Kalimdor's coast and a blow against one of the Horde's proudest peoples.
These are your people's ceremonial grounds. Every Alliance banner raised here insults the loa and Sen'jin's memory. Every banner torn down is a prayer answered.
